offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and get SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage; "Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens". Token packages: $50 / 1 Billion tokens (0.050 / 1M tokens), $500 / 11 Billion tokens (0.045 / 1M tokens)
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens (Toy Experiment, 10 Million Tokens, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC))
offerings.output_type: Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text block; returns top five results with URLs and contents in clean, LLM-friendly text
offerings.note: Rate limits: w/o key 100 RPM, free key 100 RPM, premium 1000 RPM; average latency 2.5s. In Search mode JSON response returns a list of five entries. Pricing model introduced May 6th, 2025.
